AI will not replace producers and directors, but it will accelerate production. AI previsualization, editing, and generative assets speed up repetitive work, shifting directors from managing details toward creative judgment, set coordination, and overall control, while producers shift from monitoring workflows toward resource and distribution strategy. Routine execution roles face the greatest pressure, while people with creativity and coordination skills become more valuable.
